description: Add a control-driven block-tear glitch to every selected layer.
notes: "Tear Amount" is the one dial-in control, with a default of 40 and a practical range of about 0-100, and it drives Turbulent Displace Amount through an expression. Frame Rate 12 and Size 8 are fixed defaults tuned for a blocky tear look; edit them directly on the effect for a different fps or block size..
